Sandbox utility tests for environment, descriptors, namespaces, caps, rlimits, landlock, seccomp.

# Purpose
This file is a test program for the sandbox support code in `fd_sandbox`. It exercises private helper functions that set up process isolation and privilege reduction, including environment clearing, file descriptor validation, namespace blocking, root directory changes with `pivot_root`, capability dropping, resource limit setup, Landlock restriction, seccomp filter installation, and process state changes such as dumpability and controlling terminal handling. The tests run many checks in child processes with `fork()` so the code can verify exit codes, signals, and kernel state changes without affecting the parent test process.

The file also acts as an integration test for Linux security features used by the sandbox. It checks user namespace mapping, `unshare()` behavior, capability sets, `prctl()` secure bits, `getrlimit()` values, and network namespace effects. The [`main`](<#main>) function runs each test in sequence, skips tests that require root when the process does not have elevated privileges, and ends with `fd_halt()` after all checks pass.
